nodes.title: Zoom API request
nodes.description: Call any Zoom API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/users/me/upcoming_meetings". Only the API's own host is allowed. Agent tools may only read users, meetings, past meetings, recordings and reports (start links, recording download links and passcodes are removed).

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/users/me/upcoming_meetings"
